comment: Data rules for UnitRoleClassifier. Patterns are full-match and case-insensitive. IDENTIFIER units are never translated. A unit whose value is also used as a map key or in code is LINKED and is translated together with every unit sharing that value, or not at all. linkable marks identifiers that become LINKED when a key or code literal uses the same value.
bare_json_keys_comment: UNKNOWN keeps the shared-method behaviour (keys are translated after review; BridgeForge conformance). Set to IDENTIFIER to protect every key that no value or code literal uses.
call_sites_comment: Bytecode: the first method call after a string literal is loaded decides what the literal is. PROTECT = lookup key (never translated, the unit becomes an IDENTIFIER), TEXT = shown to the player (proposed for the bytecode allowlist), REVIEW = a person decides. owner and name are full-match regexes over the internal class name (slashes) and the method name.
